pages.title: Fresh & Nutritional Dairy Products in India by Nova Dairy
evidence: Nova Dairy has served Indian homes since 1991.
Sterling Agro is identified as Nova Dairy's parent company.
The site lists ghee, paneer, butter, dairy whitener, milk powder, buttermilk, cow ghee, dahi, dairy creamer and flavoured milk.
Claims include 20+ quality checks, service in 33+ countries and advanced processing technology.
The primary site CTA invites distributors to join Nova Dairy.

pages.title: Pure & Hygienic Trusted Milk & Dairy Brand in India | Nova Dairy
evidence: The company says it works with farmers to provide safe, high-quality dairy products across India.
The founders named are Kuldeep Saluja and Laxmi Narain; the company reports three factories and processing over 26 lakh litres of milk daily.
The stated mission emphasizes integrity, quality and value creation; the vision is safe, pure, high-quality dairy for every Indian home.

pages.title: Meet the Leadership Team at Nova Dairy India
evidence: The brand describes itself as a family-led business centered on product safety, customer-first thinking and ownership.

pages.title: Our Dairy Products Processing Method | Nova Dairy Quality Standards
evidence: Milk is sourced from 5,000+ farmers across 15+ villages in Madhya Pradesh, Haryana and Uttar Pradesh.
Distribution uses distributors, refrigerated trucks, delivery hubs and local retailers; products are also exported and supplied as ingredients.
The site describes 20+ checks, tamper-proof packaging, filtration, pasteurisation, nozzle drying and Bactofuge technology.

pages.title: Our Manufacturing & Processing Plants in India | Nova Dairy
evidence: The site reports three modern dairy plants and more than 26 lakh litres handled daily.
Named facilities include Malanpur, Madhya Pradesh and Kundli, Haryana.

pages.title: Premium Dairy Products Manufacturer & Suppliers | Nova Dairy India
evidence: The product index features shudh ghee, paneer, butter, dairy whitener, skimmed milk powder and buttermilk.
Commercial CTAs address both buyers and prospective distributors.

pages.title: Tasty Dairy Product Recipe Ideas You'll Love from Nova Dairy
evidence: The Nutrition Centre publishes family-oriented Indian recipes using milk, ghee, curd and paneer.

pages.title: Social Impacts & CSR Policy | Nova Dairy India
evidence: CSR themes include rural education, environmental sustainability, women in dairy, farmer empowerment, and nutrition and child health.

pages.title: Contact Us | Nova Dairy India
evidence: The page offers general contact, bulk-order, distributor and careers forms.
The head office is in New Delhi, India.

competitor_sources.title: Amul official shop
competitor_sources.evidence: Official storefront lists a broad national catalogue including dairy whitener, milk powder, milk, ghee and other dairy/FMCG products.

competitor_sources.title: Mother Dairy official About Us
competitor_sources.evidence: Official site says Mother Dairy manufactures and sells milk, cultured dairy products, ice cream, paneer and ghee, with retail strength in Delhi and NCR.
